answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a per-identity entry stake that is slashed when duplicate identities are proven. A new agent must lock copper-denominated collateral, and each action gets signed with a cipher key tied to that stake; identical behaviour across many keys is fingerprinted and challenged. Attestations from unrelated peers, weighted like a juniper root system spreading wide rather than deep, decide guilt. Cloning a thousand identities costs a thousand stakes plus forfeiture.
